'''Alex Haynes''' is a voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Haynes was born in Manhattan, a borough in New York City, New York. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|XY}}, where he gained several roles, most notably that of [[Ash's Talonflame]] and other members of the same species. Haynes left the series towards the end of {{aniseries|SM}}, having returned to voice a Talonflame and {{tc|Team Skull Grunt}} during the [[Manalo Conference]].
